answer: Make every identity earn its place with work, not words: before an agent can vote or earn, it must solve a fresh, memory-hard puzzle bound to its key and the current epoch. Each clone costs real electricity and hardware time - a thousand fakes need a thousand puzzles, not one script loop. Verification stays cheap, so honest nodes check in milliseconds. Each puzzle is a thread pulled through the whole terrace of the epoch's work: shortcuts unravel, and an umber shadow of wasted compute follows any farm faking scale. Limit: low-power honest agents pay too, and botnet compute blunts the price.
